name: source-layout-decisions
body: Decisions for the apg-cleanup change-set, recorded because they are not derivable from the code graph. [with user] (1) Introduce a library target: `src/lib.rs` owns the module tree; `src/main.rs` becomes a thin binary — the prerequisite for moving e2e tests out of the module tree. (2) e2e → top-level `tests/`: the 310 e2e tests move to per-source-module files (`tests/main_e2e.rs`, `tests/plan_cmd_e2e.rs`, …) sharing a `tests/common/mod.rs` helper module. (3) unit + int → sibling `tests.rs`: each source module's inline `mod tests` moves to a sibling module file (e.g. `src/plan_cmd/tests.rs` via `#[cfg(test)] mod tests;`), preserving module paths so the `…::tests::unit::` / `…::tests::int::` filters keep working. (4) Decomposition over size: modules are cohesive and single-responsibility and shared logic is single-sourced; the ~400-line figure is a signal for review, never a target — splitting a file to hit the number without improving cohesion is itself a defect. Scope is repo-wide first-party source (root crate + eight frontend crates), excluding vendored (`src/cpplib/vendor/**`) and testdata (`testdata/**`). (5) Behaviour-preserving: no behaviour change; the existing suite is the proof. [autonomous] FQNs in this spec are the branch graph's language-rooted identities (`rust.apg.*`), matching the existing durable spec; the cargo aliases in `.cargo/config.toml` are libtest path filters and must be updated with the new layout.
